Project.title: Project Estimation
Project.description: A construction/framing project takeoff estimation task requested by a sales representative.

id.description: The unique ID of the project takeoff.

rep.description: The name of the sales representative who requested the takeoff.

priority.description: Whether the takeoff request has high-priority speed dispatch requirements.

dateStr.description: YYYY-MM-DD date received for calendar scheduling.

completedDateStr.description: YYYY-MM-DD date completed if status is COMPLETE.

sentForQuote.description: Whether takeoff has been completed and dispatched for quote pricing.

estimateSentAt.description: Timestamp when estimate was officially sent.

ActivityLog.title: Global Activity Log
ActivityLog.description: A centralized audit log of collaborative estimator actions for transparency.

user.description: The sales rep or estimator who performed the action.

projectName.description: The name of the target project.

action.description: The category of the action (upload, status_change, delete, spec_edit, calendar_move).

details.description: Human-readable summary of what was altered.

/projects/{projectId}.description: Estimating projects and their requirements specs.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Collaborative transparency logs for real-time estimator feed sync.
